text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_PROPOGATION_FAILURE - 2215432100. Payload validation errors observed across API gateway (401s). Paging @oncall-auth. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert details:
- Trigger: signature verification failures (JWT kid mismatch)
- Source: auth-service signing key rotation job (k8s job auth-key-rotator)
- Affected: api.redwood.com auth endpoints, token minting, token introspection
- Severity: P1

oncall-auth: Acked. Looking. I'm pulling auth rotator logs now.

sre-leyla: I'm seeing surge of 401s in prod across regions us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Error from gateway: `invalid signature: unknown kid "k_2026_03_14"` repeated. Rate ~1200/min on /v1/token/exchange.

eng-runtime-james: tagging in. Any recent deploys on auth-service or jwks propagation?

oncall-auth: We had scheduled key roll at 02:00 UTC, rotator job reported success, but the JWKS push webhook returned 202 with empty body. I'll tail the rotator job:

```
kubectl -n auth logs job/auth-key-rotator-2215432 --since=10m
INFO Rotating keys: generated new key k_2026_03_14
INFO Published JWKS to config-service /hooks/jwks/publish -> 202
INFO Marking old key as deprecated
```

prod-support-amy: customers reporting failed logins and webhook auth errors. B2B tenant ACME and Sandbox are calling in. Escalating to account execs.

sre-leyla: The gateway caches JWKS for 15m; it tried to fetch the new jwks but got 404 from CDN edge for the new path `/jwks/k_2026_03_14.json`. Looks like propagation didn't complete.

eng-runtime-james: Are keys stored in S3 backend? Could be eventual consistency on the upload path. I'll check the storage put object logs.

oncall-auth: Confirmed: s3 put returned 200 but CloudFront invalidation failed (status 400) because our invalidation job hit rate limit. So edge still serves old JWKS without new kid. Rotator marked new key active which causes signatures to be issued with new kid not present in JWKS.

sre-leyla: Mitigation plan: 1) revert rotator -> re-sign tokens with old kid (temporary), 2) force a manual JWKS upload to S3 and manual CF invalidation, 3) throttle token issuance to reduce error noise. Which one can we do quickly?

oncall-auth: I can revert rotator in the next 90s: set `AUTH_CURRENT_KID=k_2026_03_13` and redeploy auth-service config to stop issuing new kid. That will stop new tokens being minted with unknown kid.

eng-runtime-james: I'll prepare manual upload and invalidation. S3 object already exists but under `pending/` prefix. I'll move to `jwks/` and call CloudFront invalidate for `/jwks/*`.

prod-support-amy: Notifying affected customers with initial impact: authentication token issuance failing (401) for new logins and token refresh. Existing valid tokens still accepted. Workaround for customers: retry with existing tokens or reissue after we revert. Posting a statuspage incident now.

oncall-auth: Executing revert: patching configmap auth-config -> set `active_kid: k_2026_03_13`. Patching now...

```
kubectl -n auth patch configmap auth-config -p '{"data":{"active_kid":"k_2026_03_13"}}'
```

oncall-auth: Configmap patched, redeploying auth deployment to pick up config. Rolling restart started.

sre-leyla: Observing drop in new 401s within 60s. Token issuance rate still high but new tokens now have k_2026_03_13. Gateway reports signature verification OK for tokens with old kid. Confirming 5xxs not introduced.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by oncall-auth. Escalation suppressed.

eng-runtime-james: Manual JWKS upload: copied `k_2026_03_14.json` to `s3://redwood-jwks/jwks/k_2026_03_14.json` and issued CloudFront invalidation ID: INVLD-abc123. CloudFront responded 201. Polling edge to verify.

sre-leyla: Edge now serves new JWKS under path. But gateway logs show mixed kids because some clients already minted tokens signed with k_2026_03_14 during the ~2m window. We need to ensure gateway accepts both kids until clients refresh. Gateway config supports fallback kids list; adding k_2026_03_14 to accepted list.

oncall-auth: Patched gateway config to include both kids. `kubectl -n gateway patch configmap gw-jwks-accept -p '{"data":{"accepted_kids":"k_2026_03_13,k_2026_03_14"}}'`

prod-support-amy: Customer impact reduced. ACME reports refresh succeeded. Posting update to ACME and status page: "Partial authentication disruption — mitigated, ongoing validation".

pm-oliver: Noting that rotator attempted publish but our monitoring didn't detect CF invalidation failure. Add CF invalidation success/failure to rotator alerts.

eng-runtime-james: Agreed. Also adding a step to rotator: wait-for-cf-invalidation-confirmation before marking key active, or mark as pending until propagation completes.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident timeline summary so far:
- 02:00 UTC key rotator executed, published new key, CF invalidation throttled -> edge served old JWKS
- 02:02 UTC auth-service started issuing tokens with new kid -> gateway couldn't verify -> 401 surge
- 02:03 UTC oncall-auth patched config to revert to old kid -> issuance reverted, errors reduced
- 02:06 UTC manual JWKS upload + CF invalidation completed -> gateway accepts both kids

sre-leyla: Current status: 401 rates back to baseline, token issuance normal. Leaving accepted_kids with both entries for 24h to ensure no client-side caching issues.

oncall-auth: Follow-ups:
- Change rotator to confirm CF invalidation success before activating key (eng runtime)
- Add monitor for mismatch errors (gateway 401 kid mismatch) to page on threshold (sre)
- Docs: runbook update with manual JWKS steps and fallback re-sign
- Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 16:00 UTC

prod-support-amy: I've updated status page and emailed top-10 affected customers. I'll coordinate outreach if any show persistent errors.

eng-runtime-james: Quick action items I'm taking now: create PR to rotator to add wait-for-propagation step, add CloudFront error logging to rotator logs.

pm-oliver: Thanks team. Any dependent systems we should audit for similar CI jobs (key rotation) to avoid same race? Security to review schedule.

incident-bot: :hourglass: Incident will remain open until root cause analysis complete and all follow-ups are in JIRA.

sre-leyla: Logging final checks, removing paging rule suppression. If anyone sees regression, ping here.

oncall-auth: Handoff to morning oncall in 30m. I'll write a quick runbook note in the incident ticket and mark the state as "stabilized - monitoring".

prod-support-amy: Marking support ticket threads with customer communications.

eng-runtime-james: PRs: rotator fix draft -> https://git.example/r/redwood/auth/merge_requests/456 - will iterate after postmortem.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC12345 status changed to STABILIZED 2215432900.

sre-leyla: Cleaning up temporary gateway config in 24h unless we see errors. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
